scope: Complete dense gray8 multiscale Metal image-data path, from upload through pyramid, rotation, coarse and fine NCC, continuous refinement/rescue and final NMS; CPU static planning, encoding, input/output remain.
execution: Serial fresh processes, alternating paired method order between blocks; all first/measured outputs independently evaluated.
performance_gate: Every paired block: new <= baseline + max(2 ms, 10% baseline). Passing this is not proof of speedup.
memory_gate: Maximum process peak RSS <= baseline + max(8 MiB, 10% baseline). Metal retained allocation reported separately, not added to RSS.

residency_gate.meaning: Source-audited image-dependent computation only; not a hardware trace and excludes host static geometry/planning.

numeric_contract: Exact integer moments within bounded area; FP32 interpolation, normalization, optimization and geometry, not CPU-double bit identity. Final acceptance cutoff rounded upward to FP32.
phase_timing: Full path reports total, encode, final wait, device interval, explicit memcpy and final logical readback; split algorithm stage times unavailable, never interpreted as zero.
pilot: 9-case exploratory pilot retained separately; unit fixture shared failures, synchronization audit and threshold repairs precede frozen formal run.
default_policy: No GUI/default route change. Keep code and negative results regardless of performance.
